verdict.rationale: Automatic failover between LLM providers is a fair question for a self-hostable AI assistant, so the axis applies. Nothing in the evidence documents automatic fallback when a model errors or is rate-limited. 'Dynamic Model Selection' and 'Swap models' describe manually choosing a model, which is an adjacent feature. 'Break free from rate-limits' is marketing for running models locally, not a failover mechanism.

support.subject: As a self-hoster, model failover keeps the assistant working — automatic fallback to another provider or model when one errors or rate-limits
